body:
## Pull request overview

Closes remaining items from the Zod schema audit by tightening type inference (removing unsafe casts), cleaning up deprecated exports, improving schema descriptions, and updating the audit report to reflect the current state of `@objectstack/spec`.

**Changes:**
- Remove unsafe `z.ZodType<any>` cast from `SharingRuleSchema` and rely on inferred `z.discriminatedUnion` typing.
- Remove deprecated `AuthenticationSchema` / `FieldTransformSchema` re-exports from the integration connector protocol and update tests to use canonical shared auth schemas.
- Add missing `z.infer` exports, expand `.describe()` annotations, add cross-module JSDoc references, and refresh `ZOD_SCHEMA_AUDIT_REPORT.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts | Removes `any` cast to preserve discriminated union inference. |
| packages/spec/src/qa/testing.zod.ts | Expands `.describe()` coverage across QA testing schemas. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-versioning.zod.ts | Adds JSDoc cross-reference for DependencyConflict schema context. |
| packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts | Removes deprecated re-exports; uses canonical `ConnectorAuthConfigSchema`. |
| packages/spec/src/integration/connector.test.ts | Updates tests to stop using removed deprecated exports. |
| packages/spec/src/hub/plugin-security.zod.ts | Adds JSDoc cross-reference for DependencyConflict schema context. |
| packages/spec/src/api/metadata.zod.ts | Adds missing `z.infer` response type exports. |
| packages/spec/ZOD_SCHEMA_AUDIT_REPORT.md | Updates metrics/status and marks findings as resolved. |
</details>

The audit report claims there are 9 remaining `z.any()` usages, including 1 in `kernel/plugin.zod.ts` for runtime plugin instances. A repo-wide search for `z.any(` under `packages/spec/src` shows only 8 occurrences, all in `data/filter.zod.ts`, and none in `kernel/plugin.zod.ts` (the only match there is a comment). Please update the metric/bullet to match the actual remaining `z.any` locations/counts (or clarify if comments are intentionally included in the count).

This PR removes the deprecated `AuthenticationSchema` / `FieldTransformSchema` re-exports from the public integration connector protocol. Even if deprecated, removing exports is a user-facing (potentially breaking) change for downstream imports; per `.github/AUTOMATION.md` PR checklist, user-facing changes should include a changeset (or apply the `skip-changeset` label with justification).

The top-level file doc comment still says “Authentication is now imported from the canonical auth/config.zod.ts” (earlier in this file), but the actual import is `../shared/connector-auth.zod` and this section header now points there too. Please update the doc comment to avoid sending readers to the wrong canonical source.
